## `neuro.object.create`

Static method on `Object`.

> Creates an object that has the specified prototype or that has null prototype.
>
> Creates an object that has the specified prototype, and that optionally contains specified properties.

## Signatures

```ts
create(input: { o: object; prompt?: string }): Promise<any>
create(input: { o: object; properties: PropertyDescriptorMap & ThisType<any>; prompt?: string }): Promise<any>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.create` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
